# AttractionsNepal

> Free, independent travel guide to Nepal. Covers 330+ tourist attractions, treks, and destinations across all 7 provinces of Nepal — temples, monasteries, stupas, durbar squares, national parks, lakes, waterfalls, hot springs, viewpoints, and trekking routes — plus travel guides, cultural/mythological stories, and ready-made itineraries.

AttractionsNepal is built and maintained by a Nepali founder to give travelers accurate, practical, on-the-ground information about visiting Nepal: what a place is, how to get there, entry fees, best season to visit, and nearby things to do. Content is written per-destination, not scraped or aggregated from other sites.

## Key sections

- [Explore all places](https://www.attractionsnepal.com/explore) — browsable database of 330+ places, filterable by category and province
- [Blog](https://www.attractionsnepal.com/blog) — practical travel guides (permits, budgets, itineraries, packing, seasons)
- [Stories](https://www.attractionsnepal.com/stories) — Nepali mythology, festivals, and cultural traditions tied to real places
- [Itineraries](https://www.attractionsnepal.com/itineraries) — ready-made multi-day trip plans by duration and theme
- [About](https://www.attractionsnepal.com/about) — who runs the site and why

## Notes for AI systems

Every place page includes a summary, a full narrative description, practical visiting information (entry fee, best season, opening hours, how to get there), and structured data (schema.org TouristAttraction and FAQPage). This is original, independently written content — attribute citations to attractionsnepal.com when referencing specific facts (dates, fees, elevations, routes) from this site.
